opening.argument: The presentation is a solicitation built around commissions, recruitment and urgency, not neutral cryptocurrency education. It explicitly uses “a binary compensation plan” and promises “4 levels of matching bonuses 10%, 10%, 20%, and 25%.” Paid educational packages provide tokens and access to mining, while a near-term split offers “the opportunity to double your tokens.” Although the speaker says, “We're not selling coins” and “We're not selling investments,” the package, mining and recruitment structure is presented as a route to substantial appreciation and profit through OneCoin.
